name: OnnxRuntime-Encoder-Benchmark
description: Benchmark suite for measuring encoder-only model inference performance when exported to ONNX and run with ONNX Runtime (ORT). It reports runtime metrics such as latency and throughput across different hardware and optimization settings, and can be used to compare speed/efficiency tradeoffs for encoder models. The benchmark is focused on system-level performance rather than downstream task accuracy.
reputation: Provided by the Hugging Face Optimum team and used by practitioners focused on model optimization and deployment; moderate adoption in the systems/MLOps community.
